title: RedFreez
description: Plugin that finds possible redstone lag makers and gives owner ability to freeze them.
body: RedFreez is a Paper/Purpur plugin for Minecraft 1.21.x (tested on 1.21.11) that helps server owners find and control potential redstone lag hotspots. It can scan loaded chunks to highlight high-risk areas (based on redstone components) and lets admins freeze specific chunks to prevent heavy redstone activity. Players can also check whether the chunk they are standing in is frozen using /redfreez status
